title: 盛唐余韵
text: 一盏清茗，半卷残诗。窗外细雨如织，将远山晕染成一抹淡墨。此时此境，最易勾起对大唐气象的遐思。彼时之诗，不仅是文字的堆砌，更是灵魂的写照。且看王维笔下，空山新雨后，洗净了世间喧嚣。那种禅意，化作林间的一缕幽香，沁人心脾。而李白之作，则似奔涌的黄河，气势磅礴。他将明月斟入杯中，与孤独共舞。这种狂放，折射出盛世之下的自信与豪迈。杜甫之诗，则沉郁顿挫，字里行间尽是家国之忧。其忧患意识，犹如寒冬之霜，凛冽且深刻。诗人们在山水之间，构建起一座精神的殿堂。他们借物抒情，使自然景物具有了深邃的生命力。孤帆远影，传递出离愁的苦涩。长河落日，映照出英雄的苍凉。这种意象的营造，达到了艺术的极致。文白之间，韵律起伏，恰如大唐之兴衰。纵使时光荏苒，那些瑰丽的词句依然熠熠生辉。后世之人，读其诗篇，仿佛能听见千年前的钟声。那是一种超越时空的共鸣。它引导我们审视内心，体悟生命之真谛。在繁华与寂寥的交替中，寻找一份淡然。如此瑰宝，实为文化之幸。其深远影响，至今仍潜移默化地塑造着东方的审美。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what characterizes Wang Wei's poetic image "empty mountain after fresh rain"?
options: A zen-like tranquility that washes away worldly noise

questions.prompt: What does the text say Li Bai does with the bright moon in his poetry?
options: He pours it into his cup and dances with his loneliness

questions.prompt: How is Du Fu's poetry described in the text?
options: Deep and melancholic, filled with concern for his country
Purely about nature with no deeper meaning

questions.prompt: What is the author doing at the start of the passage?
options: Drinking tea and reading old poetry while it drizzles outside

questions.prompt: According to the text, what do these poets achieve by expressing feeling through natural scenery?
options: They make nature seem less important
They give natural imagery a deep, profound vitality

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.
